purpose: Teach: 脳死/永続/双方向/包囲/落選/兵力/没収/上告

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、脳死患者の関連事案を警察、慎重に扱われてますね
lines.en: I notice the police are handling this brain-death case very carefully.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured cadence. Slight pause before 'notice'—gathering his observation. Respectful toward the police work. Soft curiosity, no edge.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、永続的な地域防犯活動を継続します
lines.en: The police will continue our community crime prevention efforts.
lines.style: Official but not cold. Even, steady delivery. Confidence in institutional continuity. No flourish—just clear commitment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、双方向の情報共有を警察、なさってますね
lines.en: And I see the police are sharing information in both directions on this case.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment. Slight lift on 'both directions'—appreciating the cooperation. Still thoughtful, not challenging. Lower energy than the previous line.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者を包囲し、無事確保しました
lines.en: We managed to secure the suspect safely through an encirclement operation.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, professional understatement. Measured pride in 'safely'—this was the goal and it was met. No dramatization. Steady eye level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、市議落選後の動向も警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: The police also seem to be tracking what's happened to the former city council candidate since the loss.
lines.style: Curious but circumspect. Soft phrasing—'seem to be'—respects that details may not be public. Pause weight on 'since the loss.' Probing gently.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、テロ事案に備えて兵力配置を検討します
lines.en: We're reviewing force deployment plans in case this escalates to a terror-related incident.
lines.style: Calm preparedness. No alarm—this is routine contingency. Measured, responsible. The tone of someone thinking three moves ahead without announcing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯罪収益の没収手続を警察、進められてますね
lines.en: The police are moving forward with the asset seizure procedures in this case.
lines.style: Administrative precision. Slight emphasis on 'moving forward'—progress. Neutral, efficient. The voice of process working as it should.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、上告審の判決にも対応します
lines.en: We'll respond to whatever the appeals court decides.
lines.style: Quiet finality. Brief, accepting. No tension—this is the system working. Slight warmth underneath the official tone, like he's at peace with deferring to a higher judgment.
